chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Abi Dawud al-Mustariqq, who said: Some of our companions narrated to me, saying:

I passed with Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام in al-Madinah on a cold day, and there was a man being struck with whips. So Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said, “Subhan Allah! Is he being struck at a time like this?” I said to him, “Is there also a limit regarding striking?” He said, “Yes. If it is during the cold, he is struck in the heat of the day; and if it is during the heat, he is struck in the cool of the day.”

key_terms.الضَّرْبِ: striking; here, the implementation of corporal punishment
key_terms.بَرْدِ النَّهَارِ: the cool part of the day
key_terms.بِالسِّيَاطِ: with whips; referring to corporal punishment
key_terms.حَدٌّ: a limit or regulated standard governing an action
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ: an expression of astonishment at an improper act

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the proper time for administering flogging in hot or cold weather?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the timing of corporal punishment, indicating that it must not be carried out in a way that intensifies harm due to weather conditions. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that punishment is to be administered at the milder part of the day, reflecting restraint and regulated justice.
